liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Friend of the Devil** (1 review): First set sequence of Friend of the Devil, All Over Now, Brown Eyed Women [3]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): The Terrapin performance is considered worth the download alone [11]

## The recordings

- **gd79-01-08.gatto.glyde.10283.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 176 min; rated 3.96/5 by 51 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording features real clean sound quality throughout the performance; Quality could be better, but the music counts and rarely gets better; Crowd noise is present, but the show can be enjoyed supremely [3][6][7][10][12]
- **gd1979-01-08.nak300-wagner.miller.87657.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 184 min; rated 4.3/5 by 20 [2]

## Around the show

- Energy and music remain extraordinary from Half-Step through Good Lovin' [6]
- Rumor says a long-time NY Deadhead went to the vault for this show [8]
- Show was rescheduled from December 1, 1978 [2]
- Intensity is up during Lazy>Supp, but show is lazy with periodic fast playing [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd79-01-08.gatto.glyde.10283.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Keith Gatto; source: Audience Recording: Shure SM57's [1]. Also: No circulating SBD exists; Rob Eaton's vault lacks a copy of this show; Keith Gatto recorded this show using Nak 300 microphones, not Shure; Shntool confirmed sector boundaries; MKWact converted to shn, seekable format [1][5][8]
- **gd1979-01-08.nak300-wagner.miller.87657.flac16**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Nakamichi 300/CP1 -> Cassette Master (Maxell UDXL-II/Sony TC-158) [2]. Also: All disc changes are seamless; master cassette flips occur during Drums [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by www.gratefulseconds.com: [Madison Square Garden Took One Million Souls During Grateful Dead's 52-Show 15-Year Run, 1979-1994](http://www.gratefulseconds.com/2017/08/madison-square-garden-took-one-million.html) [16]
